title: Flyway fails on startup with 'Unsupported Database: PostgreSQL 18.1' on Spring Boot 4.0
errorSample:

	at org.flywaydb.core.internal.database.DatabaseTypeRegister.lambda$getDatabaseTypeForConnection$7(DatabaseTypeRegister.java:142) ~[flyway-core-11.14.1.jar:na]
	at java.base/java.util.Optional.orElseThrow(Optional.java:403) ~[na:na]

appliesTo.versions: 4.0.2 (spring-boot-starter-flyway; not a Boot defect, applies to 4.0.x)

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: The application context fails to start with a BeanCreationException for 'flywayInitializer', caused by FlywayException 'Unsupported Database: PostgreSQL 18.1', even though the JDBC connection to PostgreSQL succeeds.
cause: Since Flyway 10 the per-database support lives in separate modules instead of flyway-core. spring-boot-starter-flyway only brings in flyway-core, so Flyway has no PostgreSQL database type to match the connection against.
fixSummary: Add the dependency org.flywaydb:flyway-database-postgresql (version managed by the Spring Boot BOM; implementation or runtimeOnly both work). No configuration change, PostgreSQL downgrade or Flyway version change is needed.
